description: This Java class implements an email service for a book tracking application, providing methods to send simple emails and templated HTML emails using Thymeleaf and JavaMailSender.

classes.name: EmailServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of email sending functionalities, including simple text emails and HTML emails using Thymeleaf templates.

methods.name: sendSimpleMessage
methods.description: Sends a plain text email to the specified recipient with the given subject and text.

methods.name: sendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate
methods.description: Generates an HTML email from a Thymeleaf template with provided model variables and sends it.

methods.name: sendHtmlMessage
methods.description: Sends an HTML email message constructed with MimeMessageHelper.
